verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS product like Productboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The Analytics API exposes workspace usage data rather than letting users opt out, and the 'Enable MCP' workspace toggle is a different control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
